newsitem.title: USA: Southwest brings back companion fares.
newsitem.headline: Southwest brings back companion fares.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said on Friday it would bring back its so-called "Friends Fly Free" fares for all its destinations nationwide.

The fares, available for purchase through May 20 with travel good through July 22, let a customer buy a roundtrip ticket at the full unrestricted fare while a companion receives a free roundtrip ticket on the same flight.

"As the 'Low Fare Policeman' of the airline industry, Southwest Airlines is bringing back its historic Friends Fly Free promotion at the same time that the 10 percent excise tax is being reinstated," Herb Kelleher, chairman, said.
Customers have to travel on the same itinerary and a stayover of one night was required, it said.
